key_provisions_or_claims: Defines cost categories that EU reference laboratories may cover through fees.
Fees must be non-discriminatory, fair, reasonable and proportionate, and based on incurred costs.
General operating costs are capped at 7% of the other combined costs.
Laboratories must publish their fee calculation rules and review them at least every 2 years.
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/945 sets rules on fees EU reference laboratories may levy for assistance to notified bodies and Member States under the In Vitro Diagnostic Regulation 2017/746. It specifies cost categories, cost-based calculation, a 7% cap on general costs, and publication and biennial review of fee rules. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
